title: rieux_ampliseq: a multi-region CLI wrapper for nf-core/ampliseq
description:
A staged bash wrapper that runs nf-core/ampliseq across every region of a multi-region 16S/ITS amplicon panel on an HPC cluster, measures the amplicon insert in the reads themselves to choose DADA2 truncation lengths, optionally runs the q2-sidle multi-region reconstruction, and consolidates the output into a single validated set of tables.

Built for the QIAseq 16S/ITS Pro Screening Panel (96) — six 16S regions plus ITS1 — and driven by a primer table, so another panel supplies its own.
